external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: The description does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: own device at home
external_entities.description: A colleague's own device used to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by a franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The description does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, provides public signing material, and pulls group changes from the HR system.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The same signing key signs tokens for every application. Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be pulled back before expiry. The description does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application on the corporate network that lets a holder with the store-manager group change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to. The description does not state the console's technology, exposure, interface kind, or transport.

processes.name: HR system
processes.description: The system from which group membership changes are supplied to the identity broker overnight.
processes.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's store of colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether it is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying the colleague's staff id and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the token to the store admin console and uses it to change prices and void transactions when the token contains the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The token is used by applications to decide what the colleague may do from its groups.
data_flows.data_description: Token, price changes, and transaction voids

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system once each night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: Group membership and colleague status changes

data_flows.name: update membership
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleagues and their group membership from overnight HR changes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: use signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker accesses the signing key kept in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.notes: The text does not specify the exact key-store operation.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The description does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the identity broker using the franchise identity provider route.
data_flows.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
data_flows.notes: The description does not state whether the franchise route is covered by the audit log.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The description does not state which colleagues the franchise identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a franchise colleague after accepting the franchise identity provider's vouching.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker, store admin console, HR system, directory, audit log, and key store run or reside.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own device at home
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own devices used from home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by franchise stores, including franchise colleagues and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker's tokens are credentials used to authenticate and authorize access.
assumptions.basis: The broker issues tokens that applications use to decide what a colleague may do.

assumptions.assumption: The identity broker's signing key is a secret.
assumptions.basis: The broker signs tokens with a signing key kept in a key store.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console handles financial information or actions.
assumptions.basis: The console permits changing prices and voiding transactions.

assumptions.assumption: The directory contains personally identifiable information.
assumptions.basis: It stores colleagues and their group memberships.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log contains personally identifiable information.
assumptions.basis: It records sign-ins associated with colleagues.

assumptions.assumption: The HR system handles personally identifiable information.
assumptions.basis: It supplies colleague group membership and leaver changes.

assumptions.assumption: The identity-provider vouching route uses federated identity authentication.
assumptions.basis: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues and the broker accepts that as a sign-in.

assumptions.assumption: The franchise colleague's sign-in through the broker uses federated identity authentication.
assumptions.basis: The franchise identity provider vouches for the franchise colleague and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
